facts.fact: A third-party source cited by the page says 81% of consumers use Google reviews to evaluate a business and make buying decisions.
The page states that a Google My Business (GMB) profile appears among the first 3 results on Google, with a map location, when a user searches for 'something near me'.
facts.quote: It’s the first 3 results you see on Google with their map location when you search for ‘something near me’.

facts.fact: The page was last updated on July 4, 2026.
